new_work_claim: Application/implementation of existing forward sensitivity mathematics, not a new general sensitivity theorem.

read_scope.Serban-Recuero2019: Section4 equations22-28, especially memory-state terms in25a; section3 transition-time dependence. Our fixed event schedule has zero event-time derivative; all earlier cohort memories enter as additional frozen inputs, not only last transition.
read_scope.CVODES: Section4.2.7 equation4.15 and4.2.7.1 simultaneous-corrector block matrix. Block-diagonal iterative approximations in CVODES do not license passing an incomplete Jacobian as the exact Jacobian of a different stiff driver.
read_scope.Rustparallelism: Limitations: estimate only; no current workload/NUMA knowledge; affinity/cgroup query limitations. NCP preflight must inspect actual limits and available capacity.
read_scope.Rustscope: Scoped thread lifetime/join semantics; independent cases keep own ordered reductions.
